name: Fincart: Shipping Gateway
author: Fincart

sections.description:
Fincart Shipping Integration lets merchants manage the entire Fincart shipping workflow without ever leaving WordPress.
Create, update, cancel and track orders, bulk‑print shipping labels (A5, A6, thermal) and daily manifestos, and keep WooCommerce orders in sync via real‑time webhooks.

Key Features

  • One‑click order creation – send single or bulk orders to Fincart from the Orders list or Order screen.
  • Automatic field mapping – customer details, addresses (with governorate mapping), COD amounts and item descriptions are populated per Fincart specs.
  • Flexible settings – choose default pickup location, allow open package, mark order as shipped, and select description format (Qty & Title / Qty & SKU / None).
  • Bulk & single label printing – generate PDF labels in A5, A6 or thermal size.
  • Manifesto printing – hand the courier a consolidated pickup manifesto for selected orders.
  • Order edits & cancellations – if an order is still pending at Fincart, the plugin automatically calls the Update or Cancel API when you edit or trash it in WooCommerce.
  • Real‑time status sync – a public webhook endpoint updates order meta with status, sub‑status, tracking number and support notes.
  • Admin UI enhancements – new columns for Fincart Order # / Courier / Status / Notes plus quick actions (Send, Cancel, Print Label, Print Manifesto).

How It Works

  1. Enter your Access Token under WooCommerce ▸ Fincart Shipping.
  2. Choose your prefered Store Settings, Order Settings.
  3. From WooCommerce ▸ Orders, select orders and click Send to Fincart.
  4. Print labels or manifestos right away, or later via Bulk Actions.
  5. Track shipments directly in WooCommerce—statuses update automatically via webhook.

The plugin is fully compatible with WooCommerce High‑Performance Order Storage (HPOS).

External services

  • This plugin relies on an external service: Fincart (https://fincart.io/)

What is Fincart and what is it used for?

Fincart is a third-party logistics and courier management platform. This plugin integrates your WooCommerce store with Fincart, enabling you to:

  • Send customer orders to Fincart for shipping and fulfillment
  • Manage order statuses and courier assignments
  • Track orders and print shipping labels or manifestos
  • Automatically sync order updates between WooCommerce and Fincart

What data is sent, when, and why?

  • When a merchant sends an order to Fincart (manually or via auto-send), the plugin sends:
  • Order ID, customer name, phone number, shipping address information, order items(Title or SKU or none based on Admin settings), payment type, total amount to be collected at delivery.
  • When a synced order is edited or canceled, the same data is updated on Fincart.
  • When a label or manifesto is requested, the plugin sends the order ID.

Where is the data sent?

All data is sent securely to https://api.fincart.io (or the corresponding Fincart staging environment during testing). Communication is handled over HTTPS.

Under what conditions is the data sent?

Data is sent only when the store admin explicitly authorizes Fincart integration by entering their API key and configuring the plugin. Orders are sent based on merchant actions (manual or auto-send). No data is sent without admin consent and configuration.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin zip via Plugins ▸ Add New or install from the WordPress.org directory.
  2. Activate Fincart Shipping Integration.
  3. Go to WooCommerce ▸ Fincart Shipping and fill in your Access Token and other options.
  4. Start sending orders!
